title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: breakout room support
summary: Hold: the briefing assures readers that a device's existing Basic or Pro licence remains sufficient, but the documentation establishes the general Teams Rooms licensing requirement, not entitlement to this feature under both plans. The rollout dates, default state and PowerShell control are supported; narrow the licensing assurance to the published product requirement and retain the feature-specific licensing question.

claims.claim: No Teams admin center UI setting for AllowBreakoutRooms is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: AllowBreakoutRooms Teams admin center PowerShell-only audio video meeting policies setting. Opened settings-policies-reference and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; the former explicitly places AllowBreakoutRooms under PowerShell-only audio & video meeting policies.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell supports Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowBreakoutRooms $false to disable breakout rooms.
claims.quote:
Module: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy [[-Identity] <XdsIdentity>] ... [-AllowBreakoutRooms <Boolean>]
Set to true to enable Breakout Rooms, set to false to disable the Breakout Rooms functionality.

claims.claim: AllowBreakoutRooms defaults to True.
claims.quote:
### -AllowBreakoutRooms
... | Type: | Boolean |
| Default value: | True |

claims.claim: Setting AllowBreakoutRooms to true enables Breakout Rooms.
claims.quote: Set to true to enable Breakout Rooms, set to false to disable the Breakout Rooms functionality.

claims.claim: Setting AllowBreakoutRooms to false disables Breakout Rooms functionality.
claims.quote: Set to true to enable Breakout Rooms, set to false to disable the Breakout Rooms functionality.
